label: directed communication to
definition: X directs an utterance, request, warning or explicit message to Y.
scope_notes: Tell, urge, ask, notify and speak-to give the directed-communication component, preserving prior scope. Accusing or speaking about someone is insufficient without evidence of address. Sending an unspecified object alone is ambiguous; institutional speech through representatives is allowed.
